title: Footwear Color Designer I
note: Footwear color and materials; asks for 1–3 years of experience.

facts.summary: Running-footwear color designer creating colorways, material and graphic concepts.
facts.duties: Creates color, material and graphic concepts, researches trends, and builds tech packs with the Product and Development teams.
facts.requirements: Design bachelor's, 1–3 years of experience, strong color theory, Illustrator skills.
facts.apply: Apply on Workday with a portfolio (required).
